snippet.title: Snekburd Trailer
snippet.description:
Snekburd is a Pico-8 demake of Snakebird. Containing about 70 completely new levels and a couple new mechanics. Releasing April 28, 2025 for free on itch.io and the Lexaloffle BBS.

Itch.io : https://werxzy.itch.io/snekburd
Lexaloffle BBS : https://www.lexaloffle.com/bbs/?pid=166212#p
My other games : https://werxzy.itch.io/
